sn29.4:1.2: sāvatthiyaṃ: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca :
sn29.4:1.3: ko nu kho bhante, hetu, ko paccayo, yenamidhekacce jalābujā nāgā uposathaṃ upavasanti vossaṭṭhakāyā ca bhavantīti
sn29.4:1.5: ayaṃ kho bhikkhu, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo, yenamidhekacce jalābujā nāgā uposathaṃ upavasanti vossaṭṭhakāyā ca bhavantīti.
